resources.string: No apps to show. Unhide some from the ⋮ menu.

Shows what's playing in Spotify, YouTube and other apps as a small player in the top bar, with play, pause and skip.

Notification access: %1$s

Android only shows other apps' media to apps with notification access, and Android TV has no screen to turn it on. Run this once from Termux:

adb shell cmd notification allow_listener com.camdeco.launcher/com.camdeco.launcher.MediaListenerService

To turn it off again, run the same with disallow_listener.
Show artwork on. Focus Netflix, Disney+ or another streaming app.
Hold OK on an app to move, hide or uninstall it. The order here is used everywhere.
Use the arrows to move it, then press OK
Hidden. Bring it back from ⋮ → Hidden apps.
Tick the apps to show again

Deco Launcher is your Home app: %1$s
Home button override: %2$s

To make the Home button open Deco Launcher, do one of these:

1. Turn on the override: Accessibility → Deco Launcher Home button. Google TV stays installed and may flash for a moment.

2. Or disable Google TV over adb (faster, frees memory):
adb shell pm disable-user --user 0 com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx
adb shell pm disable-user --user 0 com.google.android.tungsten.setupwraith
To undo, run them with "enable" instead of "disable-user".
Opens Deco Launcher whenever the Google TV home screen appears, so the Home button takes you to Deco Launcher. It only watches for the Google TV home screen and doesn\'t read anything on your screen.
